title: Management of the neonate
text:
Calving chain
Calving jack

Management of the neonate:
1. Clear the mucus in the nose and mouth to allow the calf to breath.
a) Use a clean dry cloth.
b) Hanging the calf.
c) Use a twig to irritate the nose and stimulate the sneeze reflex.

Stimulating sneezing to remove mucus
hang the calf to remove mucus in the mouth

2. Tie the navel cord using a thread or navel clips.

Using navel clips to ligate the navel cord

facts: A calving chain is an instrument used during assisted calving to secure and pull the calf's limbs.
A calving jack is a mechanical pulling aid connected to calving chains to assist in delivering a calf.
The first step in neonate management is to clear mucus from the nose and mouth to allow the calf to breathe.
Clearing respiratory mucus can be accomplished by using a clean dry cloth.
Hanging the calf upside down or by its hind legs is a method used to remove mucus from the mouth and respiratory tract by gravity.
Inserting a twig into the calf's nose irritates the nasal passage and stimulates the sneeze reflex to expel mucus.
The second step in neonate management is to tie or ligate the navel cord.
The umbilical cord can be tied or ligated using a thread or navel clips.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of clearing mucus from a newborn calf's nose and mouth immediately after birth?

options.A: To allow the newborn calf to breathe
options.C: To lower the calf's body temperature
options.D: To prepare the calf for identification tagging

questions.question: Which of the following methods is recommended to stimulate the sneeze reflex in a newborn calf to expel nasal mucus?

options.A: Injecting saline solution into the nostrils
options.B: Using a twig to gently irritate the nose
options.C: Blowing compressed air into the nasal passage
options.D: Pinching the calf's nostrils closed for 10 seconds

questions.question: Why is a newborn calf sometimes hung upside down or suspended briefly after birth?

options.A: To stretch the calf's hind leg tendons
options.B: To drain and remove accumulated mucus from the mouth and airway
options.C: To accurately measure the calf's birth weight
options.D: To promote blood flow away from the brain

questions.question: Which materials are specified for tying or ligating the navel cord of a newborn calf?

options.A: Elastic castration bands or zip ties

questions.question: Which mechanical extraction device is shown alongside calving chains to assist in pulling a difficult calf during delivery?
Which of the following statements regarding neonate airway clearance is TRUE according to the guide?

options.A: A clean dry cloth may be used to clear mucus from the nose and mouth.
options.B: Cold water should be poured into the nasal passage to stimulate breathing.
options.C: Calf airway mucus should be left undisturbed to dissolve naturally.
options.D: Chemical stimulants are required before any physical clearing of mucus.

questions.question: What is the recommended procedure immediately following airway clearance in the management of the neonate?

options.B: Tying the navel cord using a thread or navel clips
options.C: Branding the calf for herd identification
options.D: Weaning the calf immediately from maternal milk
